entries.name: Rotwake

counterPressure.note: A grafted nozzle draws only one or two affixes at this rung. This one carries a single raw-stat line (ferocity, narrow) and nothing else that a stat sheet can price: the earth rider is elemental damage the pool would already grant on-hit, and the on-death plant spawn is board presence, not a number. It loses the stat race to an ordinary grafted rare and wins on the corpse-into-crop it leaves behind.

entries.notes: REFERENCES RESOLVE: baseType item.plant-muzzle-b-002 (plant-armament-primary-b, class nozzle, band b) is frozen wave-1a content. rarity 'grafted' is ordinal 30 of core.v1.json, this partition's assigned floor rung. Both fixedAtoms are role-legal for armament-primary as authored in their own family files (g.on-hit, g.on-death) — no generator rule broken here. atom.searing-strike's element param is set to 'earth', the one element rot-bloom's theme entry (themes.v1.json) claims, read as the nozzle spraying compost-acid rather than fire. atom.gardener (spawn a plant on death) is the rot-bloom identity atom of the whole file: the nozzle that kills also seeds what grows over the kill. Name 'Rotwake' is uniqueSetSeedPools['rot-bloom'] used bare (fusion pattern, a pre-registered seed noun), per words.v1.json poolAccess.uniquePartition.

entries.name: Composted Harness

counterPressure.note: A cultivated torso guard draws two to three affixes; this one has exactly one raw-stat line (vitality) plus a shield grant and a regen roll, both of which price separately from a flat maxHp number. Its whole identity is a corpse that keeps composting itself back into a working shell, not the biggest hp figure in the slot.

entries.notes: REFERENCES RESOLVE: baseType item.humanoid-torso-b-002 (humanoid-core-guard-b, class scale, band b) is frozen wave-1a content. rarity 'cultivated' is ordinal 40, the upper rung of this partition's assigned 30/40 band. Both fixedAtoms are role-legal for core-guard (g.sustain, g.life both list it) — no generator rule broken. atom.warded's element is 'earth' for the same reason as -001, matching rot-bloom's single claimed element. Name is 'compound' (themeAdjectivePools['rot-bloom'] 'composted' + nounPools['core-guard.humanoid'] 'harness').

entries.name: Shroud of the Turning

counterPressure.note: One raw-stat line (plating) against a grafted rung's one-to-two affix baseline, plus a shield-regen roll. The mesmerize rider is a capability a stat sheet cannot see and does not count toward the ceiling — this sheath is not competing with a plain armour rare on defense alone.

entries.notes: ROLE BREAK, SANCTIONED: atom.mesmerizing's authored `roles` (g.affliction) do not include ward-array — the affliction group's legal roles are the hit-adjacent ones (armament-primary/-secondary, manipulator, jewel-major, jewel-minor-a/-b, sense). A unique's fixed atoms are not drawn from the affix pool, so no `affix_pool_tag` filter ever applies to them (ssot-uniques.md §3.5's rule-breaking ladder, rung 2, the same device the unique exemplar demonstrates on a head-guard/on-hit pairing). No MACHINE rule is touched: status.apply's `hypno` payload is a working, unmutexed status (g-affliction.json's own notes on atom.mesmerizing), used here at its own family's lowest band precisely because turning a zombie against its allies is the strongest thing this status catalog can do. This is the control-axis row for ward-array and the whole reason the sheath is worth wearing over an ordinary grafted rare: pollen spores off a rotting sheath, not a stat. REFERENCES RESOLVE: baseType item.plant-sheath-b-001 (plant-ward-array-b, class bark, band b) is frozen wave-1a content; atom.plating and atom.shield-regen are both role-legal for ward-array in their own family files (g.armour, g.shield-stat). Name is 'of-construct': nounPools['ward-array.plant'] 'shroud' + conceptPools['rot-bloom'] 'turning' (the compost pile's own turning, not a magic-item connective invention).

entries.name: Fetid Lid

counterPressure.note: Both fixed atoms are status.clear riders, not raw stats — a cultivated off-hand rare in this slot would rather carry a flat defensive number, which this focus deliberately does not. The single raw-stat line is the rolled mending slot, well under a cultivated rung's two-to-three affix baseline.

entries.notes: REFERENCES RESOLVE: baseType item.humanoid-off-hand-a-001 (humanoid-armament-secondary-a, class focus, band a) is frozen wave-1a content. All three atoms are role-legal for armament-secondary as authored (g.sustain lists it for cleansing and sust-freshgraft; g.life lists it for mending) — no generator rule broken. atom.sust-freshgraft ('a new graft carries none of the old plant's rot', g-sustain.json's own note) is the rot-bloom identity atom here: a lid that lets whatever is underneath start over clean. Name is 'compound': themeAdjectivePools['rot-bloom'] 'fetid' + nounPools['armament-secondary.humanoid'] 'lid'.

entries.name: Wormtithe

counterPressure.note: Every atom on this pollen sac is a resource.economy rider, and none of the three is a raw combat stat — a grafted jewel-major rare would rather carry a defensive or offensive line, which this one has none of. It pays out on kills and hits landed, and it pays nothing while the wearer is standing still.

entries.notes: REFERENCES RESOLVE: baseType item.plant-pollen-a-001 (plant-pollen-a, class spore, band a) is frozen wave-1a content. All three atoms are role-legal for jewel-major (g.economy lists it) — no generator rule broken. atom.sunbloom and atom.econ-bounty ('Rot Bounty' — a decay/harvest-flavoured kill ledger per g-economy.json's own note) are both economy-axis by family design, matching this row's allocation directly. Name is 'fusion': uniqueSetSeedPools['rot-bloom'] 'wormtithe' used bare, per words.v1.json poolAccess.uniquePartition.

entries.name: Claw of the Glut

counterPressure.note: atom.savagery is a `More`-op multiplier, ssot-affixes.md's own named example of a rare-tier-band-only family — its floor is powerBand 'high' with no lower rung, so this claw is fixed at that ceiling rather than rolled into it. Against that, the only rolled raw-stat line is the might variance slot; the poison rider is a status, not a stat, keeping the summed raw-stat count under a cultivated rung's own two-to-three affix baseline.

entries.notes: REFERENCES RESOLVE: baseType item.humanoid-hands-b-002 (humanoid-manipulator-b, class scale, band b) is frozen wave-1a content. All three atoms are role-legal for manipulator as authored (g.affliction and g.attack both list it) — no generator rule broken. Name is 'of-construct': nounPools['manipulator.humanoid'] 'claw' + conceptPools['rot-bloom'] 'glut' (an overabundance the decay cycle produces, not a magic-item connective).

entries.name: Overgrown Canopy

counterPressure.note: atom.bulwark is this group's own named rare-tier-band family (ssot-affixes.md §4.4, alongside savagery); its floor is 'high' with nothing beneath it, so it is fixed rather than rolled. One raw-stat line at that ceiling plus a shield grant and a rolled regen tick stay within a grafted rung's one-to-two affix baseline once the shield (not a stat channel) is set aside.

entries.notes: REFERENCES RESOLVE: baseType item.plant-canopy-b-001 (plant-mantle-b, class bark, band b) is frozen wave-1a content. Both fixedAtoms are role-legal for mantle as authored (g.life and g.sustain both list it) — no generator rule broken. atom.warded's element is 'earth', matching this partition's other uses. Name is 'compound': themeAdjectivePools['rot-bloom'] 'overgrown' + nounPools['mantle.plant'] 'canopy'.

entries.name: Mouldreign

counterPressure.note: One raw-stat line (stoicism) plus a rolled ward-brace slot, both well under a cultivated rung's two-to-three affix baseline. The wither rider is a status-over-time effect a stat sheet cannot price, and it is the entire reason to wear a crown that otherwise loses the stat race to a plain cultivated helm.

entries.notes: ROLE BREAK, SANCTIONED: atom.withering's authored `roles` (g.affliction) do not include head-guard — the same hit-adjacent role list as atom.mesmerizing above. A unique's fixed atoms sit in the container's fixed core, never drawn from the affix pool, so no `affix_pool_tag` filter reaches them (ssot-uniques.md §3.5's rule-breaking ladder, the same device used on -003). No MACHINE rule is touched: g-affliction.json's own notes call status='wither' 'fully functional today with no missing payload half'. This is the control-axis row for head-guard: a crown that saps and slows rather than one that merely blocks. REFERENCES RESOLVE: baseType item.humanoid-head-b-002 (humanoid-head-guard-b, class leather, band b) is frozen wave-1a content; atom.stoicism and atom.ward-brace are both role-legal for head-guard in their own family file (g.ward). Name is 'fusion': uniqueSetSeedPools['rot-bloom'] 'mouldreign' used bare, per words.v1.json poolAccess.uniquePartition.
